description:
We are currently seeking an experienced Director to lead the development and execution of NVIDIA's government relations strategy for Latin America.  The position will report to the Head of Global Policy.  


We are looking for a highly collaborative, hands-on leader with background and existing deep network with government and policy leaders (including government ministries, think tanks, national and regional initiatives, research institutions, trade associations and industry partners).  You will take ownership of projects end-to-end, from concept to implementation, and be ready to use your creativity to overcome problems. 


What You'll Be Doing: 

  • Track and analyze policy developments, provide internal policy recommendations, brief NVIDIA senior executives, develop engagement strategies and engage senior policy makers. 
  • Cross functional collaboration with other NVIDIA teams, including legal, business development, sales, marketing, and PR to advance NVIDIA’s business interests in Latin America. 
  • Educate policy makers and thought leaders on NVIDIA technology and advise on national AI strategies.  
  • Track AI policy and regulatory development in key Latin American markets and prepare regular summaries for NV leadership.  
  • Collaborate closely with ecosystem partners on shared policy and regulatory priorities.  

 

What We Need To See:

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience in political science, international relations, public policy, or a related field.
  • 15+ overall year's experience in Latin America government affairs, public policy, corporate affairs, consulting, or a government or multilateral institution — or equivalent experience through internship, academic, or policy research roles. 
  • 5+ years of management or leadership experience.
  • In depth knowledge of regional regulatory processes and technology policies and priorities and understanding of regional and geopolitical landscape. 
  • Strong relationships across key Ministries and political leaders in Latin America.  
  • Strong judgement and diplomatic skills.  Understanding of cultural and political expectations and norms.  
  • Excellent written and spoken communication skills are a must, including fluency in English and Spanish or Portuguese.  
  • Excellent organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple concurrent workstreams with strong attention to detail. 
  • Experience working on AI, semiconductor manufacturing, digital economy, or technology policy issues.  


Ways to stand out from a crowd:

  • Ability to understand and evaluate multiple perspectives, considering all sides of an issue before making recommendations.
  • Strong candidates can demonstrate how they aligned policy strategy with business goals.


With competitive salaries and a generous benefits package, NVIDIA is widely considered to be one of the technology world’s most desirable employers. We have some of the most forward-thinking and hardworking people in the world working for us. This role presents an opportunity to have a wide impact at NVIDIA by improving the factory planning function. Are you creative, hard-working, dedicated, and determined? Do you love a challenge? If so, we want to hear from you!
